metadata.checkpoint_note: Scores use saved issued CSGD parameters, expected rainfall and probabilities. HRRR records generation model filenames; its historical weight bytes are not authenticated by these NPZs. These are separate from the frozen research checkpoints.
metadata.observation_note: A complete cycle has 8 six-hour, 7 twelve-hour and 5 twenty-four-hour windows, each with full canonical land coverage. Partial cycles and masked cells are identified; unverified periods are not scored.
metadata.reference_note: Both systems use the same frozen monthly MRMS event-frequency reference from available 2021–2023 observations.
metadata.sample_note: Same initialization, duration, valid interval, common 0.25° CONUS grid and finite nonnegative MRMS land observations. Scores give equal weight to retained point–window pairs; examples are dependent.
metadata.score_units: CRPS/MAE/RMSE/bias in mm; probabilities and skill scores as fractions.
metadata.title: Issued operational forecasts 2026110806
